# Usage reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_reference.py from the argparse parser. Do not edit; run `just reference`. -->

> polymorph is experimental and unvetted. It sits on a safety path (guard hooks), where a wrong mapping can fail open. Nothing here promises compatibility.

This page lists every command and flag exactly as the program defines them. [The CLI reference](cli.md) explains what they do.

## polymorph manage

Maintainer half: keep the basecamp and generate harness configs.

```
polymorph manage COMMAND
```

## polymorph manage generate

Write harness configs from .agents/settings.json.

```
polymorph manage generate [--repo REPO] [--harness HARNESS ...] [--check] [--mappings MAPPINGS] [--trust-dir TRUST_DIR ...]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--repo REPO` | repository root (default .) |
| `--harness HARNESS` | harness to generate for; repeatable (default: those enabled in .polymorph/basecamp/config.toml) |
| `--check` | exit 1 on drift, write nothing |
| `--mappings MAPPINGS` | directory of mappings to load; must be trusted (see --trust-dir) |
| `--trust-dir TRUST_DIR` | additional directory mappings may be loaded from; repeatable |

## polymorph manage check

Static analysis of the repo's agent config (runs nothing, writes nothing).

```
polymorph manage check [--repo REPO] [--harness HARNESS ...] [--format {text,json,sarif}] [--strict]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--repo REPO` | repository root (default .) |
| `--harness HARNESS` | harness to check; repeatable (default: those enabled in .polymorph/basecamp/config.toml) |
| `--format {text,json,sarif}` | output format (default text) |
| `--strict` | warnings also fail the run |

## polymorph manage validate

Validate a mapping file.

```
polymorph manage validate file
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `file` | path of the mapping TOML to validate |

## polymorph manage conformance

Run fixtures against mappings.

```
polymorph manage conformance [--harness HARNESS]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--harness HARNESS` | replay only this harness's fixtures (default: all) |

## polymorph manage adopt

Move agent files at rest into the basecamp store and symlink them back.

```
polymorph manage adopt [--repo REPO] [--dry-run]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--repo REPO` | repository root (default .) |
| `--dry-run` | report what would move; write nothing |

## polymorph equip

The onboarding run: write the loadout and report honoured surface, gaps and the env contract.

```
polymorph equip [--repo REPO] --harness HARNESS [--dry-run] [--gitignore]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--repo REPO` | repository root (default .) |
| `--harness HARNESS` | harness to equip |
| `--dry-run` | write nothing; report what equip would do |
| `--gitignore` | contributor posture: append the marked regenerable-artifacts section to .gitignore |

## polymorph adapter

Run a hook script through a harness adapter.

```
polymorph adapter --harness HARNESS [--mappings MAPPINGS] [--trust-dir TRUST_DIR ...] [--repo REPO] [--timeout TIMEOUT] script...
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `script` | after `--`: hook script (and args) |
| `--harness HARNESS` | harness whose mapping translates the payload |
| `--mappings MAPPINGS` | directory of mappings to load; must be trusted (see --trust-dir) |
| `--trust-dir TRUST_DIR` | additional directory mappings may be loaded from; repeatable |
| `--repo REPO` | repository root (default: the nearest directory above the working directory with .agents/) |
| `--timeout TIMEOUT` | seconds before the hook is killed (default 60); a killed hook is NOT checked, never a deny |

## polymorph inventory

The repo's discover-and-report surface and each harness's gaps.

```
polymorph inventory [--repo REPO] [--harness NAME ...] [--json]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--repo REPO` | repository root (default .) |
| `--harness NAME` | coverage tables to report (default: every table found) |
| `--json` | machine-readable output |

## polymorph env

Emit the env contract from .polymorph/basecamp/env.toml, or run a command under it.

```
polymorph env [--repo REPO] [--harness NAME] [--exec CMD]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--repo REPO` | repository root (default .) |
| `--harness NAME` | harness whose session markers to emit |
| `--exec CMD` | run CMD under sh -c with the contract applied, and exit with its status |

## polymorph capture

Run the discovery procedure against a harness, headless, in a scratch directory.

```
polymorph capture [--harness HARNESS] [--yes] [--keep] [--steps STEP] [--step-timeout SECONDS] [--total-timeout SECONDS] [--out DIR] [--print-prompts] [--full] [--i-really-want-this-in-the-repo-raw]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--harness HARNESS` | driver name (see below); required unless --print-prompts |
| `--yes` | skip the typed confirmation (required when stdin is not a terminal) |
| `--keep` | keep the scratch directory afterwards |
| `--steps STEP` | run only these steps, in the fixed order: shell, file, search, background |
| `--step-timeout SECONDS` | kill a step after this many seconds (default 120.0) |
| `--total-timeout SECONDS` | skip the remaining steps after this many seconds (default 600.0) |
| `--out DIR` | results directory (default ./polymorph-capture-NAME; must be absent or empty) |
| `--print-prompts` | print the prompt kit for a harness with no driver, run nothing, exit 0 |
| `--full` | log raw payloads (commands, paths, contents); default is redacted. Needs --out and the long flag below, then asks you to type yes |
| `--i-really-want-this-in-the-repo-raw` | required with --full: accept a plain-text raw log (then type yes when asked) |

## polymorph discover

Log a harness's hook payloads and draft a mapping.

```
polymorph discover COMMAND
```

## polymorph discover init

Add a catch-all logger hook to a config, keeping the hooks already there.

```
polymorph discover init --harness HARNESS --config-path CONFIG_PATH [--event-name EVENT_NAME] [--matcher MATCHER] [--shape {claude-settings,claude-like}] [--log-dir LOG_DIR] [--env-be-very-careful] [--full] [--i-really-want-this-in-the-repo-raw]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--harness HARNESS` | harness name; names the log file |
| `--config-path CONFIG_PATH` | the harness config file to add the logger hook to |
| `--event-name EVENT_NAME` | native event to hook (default PreToolUse) |
| `--matcher MATCHER` | tool matcher for the hook (default *) |
| `--shape {claude-settings,claude-like}` | claude-settings: hooks.<Event> (Claude Code, its SDK); claude-like: ZCode |
| `--log-dir LOG_DIR` | absolute log directory (default ./.polymorph/discovery; required with --full) |
| `--env-be-very-careful` | WARNING: makes the logger read the process environment and record the NAMES (never values) of PROJECT/WORKSPACE/HARNESS-like variables, visibly baked into the hook command |
| `--full` | log raw payloads (commands, paths, contents); default is redacted. Needs --log-dir and the long flag below, then asks you to type yes |
| `--i-really-want-this-in-the-repo-raw` | required with --full: accept a plain-text raw log (then type yes when asked) |

## polymorph discover log

Append stdin to a JSONL log (always exits 0, silent).

```
polymorph discover log --out OUT [--env-be-very-careful] [--full]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--out OUT` | JSONL file to append one line to |
| `--env-be-very-careful` | log names (never values) of PROJECT/WORKSPACE/HARNESS-like env vars |
| `--full` | log raw payloads; default replaces values with {type, length} |

## polymorph discover reload-check

Test whether a running harness re-reads hook edits.

```
polymorph discover reload-check --config-path CONFIG_PATH --scratch-log SCRATCH_LOG [--finish] [--event-name EVENT_NAME] [--matcher MATCHER] [--shape {claude-settings,claude-like}]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--config-path CONFIG_PATH` | the harness config file under test |
| `--scratch-log SCRATCH_LOG` | log file the temporary hook writes to |
| `--finish` | report, then remove the temporary hook |
| `--event-name EVENT_NAME` | native event to hook (default PreToolUse) |
| `--matcher MATCHER` | tool matcher for the hook (default *) |
| `--shape {claude-settings,claude-like}` | default: detected from the existing file |

## polymorph discover summary

Table of keys, tools and counts in a discovery log.

```
polymorph discover summary [--include EVENT ...] [--event EVENT ...] file
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `file` | discovery log (JSONL) |
| `--include EVENT` | also use lines of this event (repeatable); default is tool events only |
| `--event EVENT` | use only lines of this event (repeatable), replacing the tool-event default |

## polymorph discover draft

Print a draft mapping from a discovery log.

```
polymorph discover draft --name NAME [--include EVENT ...] [--event EVENT ...] file
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `file` | discovery log (JSONL) |
| `--name NAME` | name of the drafted mapping |
| `--include EVENT` | also use lines of this event (repeatable); default is tool events only |
| `--event EVENT` | use only lines of this event (repeatable), replacing the tool-event default |
